strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct every L1 lower-bound attribution to the actual lower theorem in the cited Jiao--Han--Weissman version, while retaining Construction 2 and its performance theorem only for the upper construction.

Replace the generic local near-minimax polynomial selection with an explicit pointwise-controlled approximation construction, or prove that the selected local best approximation supplies the pointwise bias control needed near both sparse faces and the tie diagonal.

Add a computational corollary with a finite certified approximation routine and explicit complexity in d, n, and requested numerical precision, separating arithmetic computability from practical implementation.

recommended_next_step: Repair the Jiao--Han--Weissman lower-bound attribution, then return this otherwise flagship-grade sharp-frontier proposal to Stage 0.
